primary.title: Discourse on the Method
primary.author: René Descartes
primary.rationale: Descartes' seminal work outlining his philosophical method and foundational ideas. Widely translated and studied.

primary.title: Meditations on First Philosophy
primary.author: René Descartes
primary.rationale: A cornerstone of Western philosophy, presenting his arguments for the existence of God and the distinction between mind and body.

primary.title: Principles of Philosophy
primary.author: René Descartes
primary.rationale: A systematic exposition of his philosophy, covering metaphysics, physics, and cosmology.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Descartes
secondary.author: John Cottingham
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Descartes' philosophy.

secondary.title: Descartes: A Biography
secondary.author: John J. O'Neill
secondary.rationale: A scholarly biography providing context for Descartes' life and intellectual development.

secondary.title: Descartes's Mathematical Thought
secondary.author: Jérôme Lamy
secondary.rationale: An academic book focusing on the crucial role of mathematics in Descartes' philosophical system.

suggestions.notes: Descartes' major works are widely available in multiple translations and editions across digital archives. The secondary sources selected are from reputable academic presses and cover different facets of his thought and life.
